<style>/* Copyright Proa Labs, Inc. */
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 */

@font-face {
  font-family: 'Airbnb Cereal VF';
  src: url('https://a0.muscache.com/airbnb/static/airbnb-dls-web/build/fonts/cereal-variable/AirbnbCerealVF_W_Wght.8816d9e5c3b6a860636193e36b6ac4e4.woff2') format('woff2-variations');
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Airbnb Cereal VF';
  src: url('https://a0.muscache.com/airbnb/static/airbnb-dls-web/build/fonts/cereal-variable/AirbnbCerealVF_Italics_W_Wght.bd5e0f97cea11e9264b40656a83357ec.woff2') format('woff2-variations');
  font-style: italic;
  font-display: swap;
}
:root {
  --air-text: #222222;
  --air-muted: #6a6a6a;
  --air-line: #ebebeb;
  --air-line-strong: #dddddd;
  --air-soft: #f7f7f7;
  --air-pink: #ff385c;
  --air-proa-accent: #ff6a13;
  --air-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  --air-shadow-soft: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  --air-header-height: 80px;
}
html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
body {
  font-family: "Airbnb Cereal VF", Circular, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif;
  color: var(--air-text);
  background: #fbfaf7;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  font-synthesis: none;
}
a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.air-shell {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-inline: 24px;
  overflow-x: clip;
}
.air-bounded {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1280px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
@media (min-width: 744px) {
  .air-shell {
    padding-inline: 40px;
  }
}
@media (min-width: 1128px) {
  .air-shell {
    padding-inline: 80px;
  }
}
.air-muted {
  color: var(--air-muted);
}
.air-link:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.heart-btn svg {
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, fill 0.2s ease, stroke 0.2s ease;
}
.heart-btn:hover svg {
  transform: scale(1.08);
}
.heart-btn.saved svg {
  fill: var(--air-pink);
  stroke: var(--air-pink);
}
.air-topbar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 50;
  background: rgba(251, 250, 247, 0.94);
  backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(12px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e7e1d7;
}
.air-topbar-inner {
  min-height: var(--air-header-height);
}
.air-search-pill {
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), 0 12px 28px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
}
.air-search-pill:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--air-shadow-soft);
}
.air-tab {
  position: relative;
  color: var(--air-muted);
  transition: color 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
}
.air-tab::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -14px;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
  transform: scaleX(0.72);
}
.air-tab:hover {
  color: var(--air-text);
}
.air-tab.active {
  color: var(--air-text);
}
.air-tab.active::after {
  background: var(--air-text);
  transform: scaleX(1);
}
.filter-pill.is-selected {
  background: var(--air-text);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: var(--air-text);
}
.air-card-image {
  border-radius: 18px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.air-card-image img {
  transition: transform 0.35s ease;
}
.group:hover .air-card-image img {
  transform: scale(1.03);
}
.air-quiet-shadow {
  box-shadow: var(--air-shadow);
}
.air-booking-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--air-line);
  border-radius: 24px;
  box-shadow: var(--air-shadow-soft);
}
.air-calendar[data-calendar] {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-header] {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-heading] {
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #222;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-prev],
.air-calendar [data-calendar-next] {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: #222;
  background: transparent;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-prev]:hover,
.air-calendar [data-calendar-next]:hover {
  background: var(--air-soft);
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-header] {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-heading] {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-weekdays] {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  color: var(--air-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-grid] {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
  gap: 8px 0;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-day] {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  color: #222;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-day]:hover:not(:disabled):not([data-range-start]):not([data-range-end]):not([data-state="selected"]) {
  background: var(--air-soft);
  color: #222;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-day][data-outside],
.air-calendar [data-calendar-day]:disabled {
  opacity: 0.38;
  cursor: default;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-day][data-in-range] {
  background: var(--air-soft);
  color: #222;
  border-radius: 0;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-day][data-range-start],
.air-calendar [data-calendar-day][data-range-end],
.air-calendar [data-calendar-day][data-state="selected"] {
  background: #222;
  color: #fff;
}
.air-calendar [data-calendar-day][data-range-start]:hover,
.air-calendar [data-calendar-day][data-range-end]:hover,
.air-calendar [data-calendar-day][data-state="selected"]:hover {
  background: #222;
  color: #fff;
}
.airbnb-booking-trigger[data-active="true"] {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #222;
  background: #fff;
}
.airbnb-booking-card {
  border-radius: 24px;
}
.airbnb-booking-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 44px;
  border: 1px solid var(--air-line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #fff;
  padding: 0 18px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #222;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}
.airbnb-booking-display[data-empty="true"],
.airbnb-popover-value[data-empty="true"] {
  color: var(--air-muted);
}
.airbnb-booking-popover {
  position: absolute;
  top: 92px;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 40;
  width: min(720px, calc(100vw - 48px));
  border: 1px solid var(--air-line);
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}
.airbnb-booking-popover.hidden {
  display: none;
}
.airbnb-popover-shell {
  padding: 18px 18px 16px;
}
.airbnb-popover-header {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(320px, 360px);
  align-items: start;
  gap: 20px;
}
.airbnb-popover-fields {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid #b0b0b0;
  border-radius: 12px;
}
.airbnb-popover-field {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 58px;
  padding: 10px 34px 10px 12px;
  text-align: left;
  background: #fff;
}
.airbnb-popover-field + .airbnb-popover-field {
  border-left: 1px solid #b0b0b0;
}
.airbnb-popover-field-label {
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #222;
}
.airbnb-popover-field-value {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: #222;
}
.airbnb-popover-clear {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  right: 8px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  color: #222;
}
.airbnb-popover-clear:hover {
  background: var(--air-soft);
}
.airbnb-popover-summary {
  padding: 6px 0 0;
}
.airbnb-popover-summary h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 28px;
  line-height: 34px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #222;
}
.airbnb-popover-summary p {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 18px;
  color: var(--air-muted);
}
.airbnb-popover-calendars {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.airbnb-popover-calendar {
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 4px 4px 0;
}
.airbnb-popover-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding-top: 16px;
}
.airbnb-link-button {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #222;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}
.airbnb-close-button {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #222;
  padding: 11px 18px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #fff;
}
.airbnb-guest-favorite {
  border: 1px solid var(--air-line);
  border-radius: 28px;
  padding: 28px 32px;
}
.airbnb-favorite-strip {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 180px minmax(0, 1fr) 120px;
  align-items: stretch;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--air-line);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: #fff;
}
.airbnb-favorite-badge,
.airbnb-favorite-copy,
.airbnb-favorite-score {
  padding: 18px 20px;
}
.airbnb-favorite-badge,
.airbnb-favorite-copy {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--air-line);
}
.airbnb-favorite-badge {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.airbnb-favorite-copy {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 22px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #222;
}
.airbnb-favorite-score {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 4px;
  text-align: center;
}
.airbnb-guest-favorite-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 92px minmax(0, 1fr) 92px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 24px;
}
.airbnb-guest-favorite-art {
  width: 92px;
  height: 132px;
  object-fit: contain;
}
.airbnb-rating-bars {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}
.airbnb-rating-bar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
}
.airbnb-rating-bar-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #222;
}
.airbnb-rating-bar-track {
  height: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--air-line);
}
.airbnb-rating-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #222;
}
.airbnb-ratings-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.airbnb-ratings-row::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}
.airbnb-ratings-card {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 160px;
  min-height: 160px;
  padding: 20px 16px;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--air-line);
}
.airbnb-ratings-card:last-child {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--air-line);
}
.airbnb-ratings-card-overall {
  width: 240px;
}
.airbnb-ratings-card-label {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #222;
}
.airbnb-ratings-card-score {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: #222;
  margin-top: auto;
}
.airbnb-ratings-card-icon {
  color: #222;
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.airbnb-guest-fav-badge {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 24px 0 32px;
}
.airbnb-guest-fav-laurels {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0;
  height: 132px;
}
.airbnb-guest-fav-laurel {
  width: auto;
  height: 132px;
  object-fit: contain;
}
.airbnb-guest-fav-score {
  font-size: 100px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  line-height: 1;
  color: #222;
  padding: 0 8px;
}
.airbnb-guest-fav-title {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #222;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.airbnb-guest-fav-desc {
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: #6a6a6a;
  max-width: 400px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.airbnb-review-card[data-expanded="false"] [data-review-body] {
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.airbnb-review-card[data-expanded="true"] [data-review-body] {
  display: block;
}
.airbnb-review-stars {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2px;
